basic_info.description: Discover modern urban living at 4132 3rd Street #3! This stylish 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom townhome offers 1,391 sqft of sleek design, featuring an open floor plan, high ceilings, and abundant natural light. The gourmet kitchen boasts quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and high-gloss cabinetry, while luxurious bathrooms showcase custom-tiled showers and soaking tubs. Enjoy the convenience of a private garage and prime access to local shops, dining, and public transportation. Right next to Flora Grubb Gardens as well! Don't miss this opportunityschedule a viewing today!
